    Profile

    A mysterious young girl known as Bianca. Her name means "white" in a foreign tongue. While lacking the power of her other self, she instead bears knowledge all her own. She is interested in the consequences of human actions, and sometimes lends assistance to satisfy her curiosity. Her innocence and purity inspire awe in those she meets.
